# acme-schema

Database schema of the Acme platform: migrations and policies.

## Notes

- Keep acme-schema changes small and reviewed.
- See the changelog for older acme-schema notes.
- Version 3 of this section was reviewed in the last cycle.
- Version 4 of this section was reviewed in the last cycle.

files.migrations/0001_init.sql: create table lessons (id uuid primary key, title text not null);
files.migrations/0002_progress.sql: create table progress (lesson_id uuid references lessons(id), step int not null);

commits.message: ci: validate migrations on pull requests

files..github/workflows/validate-migrations.ym:
name: validate
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, acme-runner]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx dbtool lint migrations
      - run: npx dbtool push --dry-run

commits.message: ci: apply migrations to production after merge

files..github/workflows/push-migrations.yml:
name: apply
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [migrations/**]
jobs:
  apply:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, acme-runner]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "prepare step 1"
      - run: echo "prepare step 2"
      - run: npx dbtool push --target production

Two skills are duplicates when their `purpose:` lines describe the same job.
A similar NAME is not enough.

files.docs/ci-rules.md:
# CI rules

- Run the checks locally before you open a pull request.
Rule R1: every job of a PRIVATE repository runs on the self-hosted runner `[self-hosted, acme-runner]`.
Rule R2: a PUBLIC repository may use `ubuntu-latest`, because the self-hosted runner refuses public repositories.

service: payments
env:
  - name: PAYMENTS_API_KEY
    from: vault:/payments/PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
  - name: PAYMENTS_REGION
    value: eu-1
